preconditions: this points to a live F1CVehicle instance (owner CONFIRMED in packet IR).
Vehicle not retired (byte at +0x4410 == 0) for the writes to occur; otherwise the function is a read-only pass.
postconditions: If +0x4410 was zero: +0x4424 (dword) is zeroed and +0x45F4 (byte) is set to 1.
If +0x4410 was nonzero: no writes; both +0x4424 and +0x45F4 are left unchanged.
Returns the original +0x4410 byte on both paths.
side_effects: Clears the cleanup/disqualification flag dword at +0x4424 to 0 when the vehicle is not retired.
Sets the session-active flag byte at +0x45F4 to 1 when the vehicle is not retired.

lifecycle.phase: per-frame session-active flag setter; no cross-call state owned
